description: Generate an AI image and attach it as a post's featuredImage. Submits a kie.ai job, polls until complete, copies the result into the canonical post-asset R2 folder, and writes the public URL onto the post. Costs credits (see list_image_models). On poll timeout, the job continues — call attach_post_cover_from_job(postId, jobId) once it finishes to attach without paying again.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio passed to the model, e.g. "16:9", "1:1"

modelCode.description: Image model code from list_image_models (e.g. nano-banana-2)

name: generate_post_cover

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
